data.text:
Now I'll run a SQL query to find distinct customers who bought items in the furniture_decor category. The plan is:
1. Join orders with order_items (to get product_id)
2. Join with products (to get Portuguese category name)
3. Join with category_translation (to filter for 'furniture_decor' English name)
4. Filter out canceled/unavailable orders
5. Join with customers to get customer_unique_id
6. Count distinct customer_unique_id

args.purpose: Count distinct customers who bought items in the furniture_decor category
args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) as distinct_customers
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE ct.product_category_name_english = 'furniture_decor'
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
